'''28th title ''' |} == Torneo Clausura == The '''Campeonato de Clausura''', also the '''Torneo [[Millicom|Tigo]] Clausura''' for sponsorship reasons, is the second championship of the season. It began on July 25 and end on December 13. '''7th title ''' |} == International qualification == The two tournament champions earn the ''Paraguay 1'' and ''Paraguay 2'' berths in the Second Stage of the [[2010 Copa Libertadores]]. All remaining international qualification will be determined through a season-wide aggregate table. The ''Paraguay 3'' in the 2010 Copa Libertadores berth goes to the best-placed non-champion. For the [[2010 Copa Sudamericana]], the ''Paraguay 1'' berth goes to the highest placed champion. ''Paraguay 2'' and ''Paraguay 3'' will go to the highest placed teams who have not qualified to an international tournament. {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=QR |team1=LIB|name_LIB=[[Club Libertad|Libertad]] |team2=CER|name_CER=[[Cerro Porteño]] |team3=NAC|name_NAC=[[Club Nacional|Nacional]] |team4=OLI|name_OLI=[[Club Olimpia|Olimpia]] |team5=GUA|name_GUA=[[Club Guaraní|Guaraní]] |team6=TAC|name_TAC=[[Tacuary]] |team7=RUB|name_RUB=[[Club Rubio Ñu|Rubio Ñu]] |team8=SLU|name_SLU=[[Club Sportivo Luqueño|Sportivo Luqueño]] |team9=SOL|name_SOL=[[Club Sol de América|Sol de América]] |team10=FEB|name_FEB=[[Club Atlético 3 de Febrero|3 de Febrero]] |team11=OCT|name_OCT=[[Club 12 de Octubre|12 de Octubre]] |team12=MAY|name_MAY=[[Club 2 de Mayo|2 de Mayo]] |win_LIB=24|draw_LIB=10|loss_LIB=10|gf_LIB=77|ga_LIB=39|status_LIB=Q |win_CER=23|draw_CER=12|loss_CER=9|gf_CER=52|ga_CER=36 |win_NAC=21|draw_NAC=14|loss_NAC=9|gf_NAC=66|ga_NAC=39 |win_OLI=20|draw_OLI=10|loss_OLI=14|gf_OLI=63|ga_OLI=50 |win_GUA=18|draw_GUA=13|loss_GUA=13|gf_GUA=51|ga_GUA=38 |win_TAC=18|draw_TAC=10|loss_TAC=16|gf_TAC=52|ga_TAC=60 |win_RUB=18|draw_RUB=9|loss_RUB=17|gf_RUB=59|ga_RUB=56 |win_SLU=13|draw_SLU=12|loss_SLU=19|gf_SLU=45|ga_SLU=56 |win_SOL=13|draw_SOL=11|loss_SOL=20|gf_SOL=46|ga_SOL=60 |win_FEB=12|draw_FEB=7|loss_FEB=25|gf_FEB=45|ga_FEB=82 |win_OCT=11|draw_OCT=8|loss_OCT=25|gf_OCT=36|ga_OCT=63 |win_MAY=10|draw_MAY=10|loss_MAY=24|gf_MAY=48|ga_MAY=61 |col_CLFS=#D0F0C0|text_CLFS=[[2010 Copa Libertadores#First stage|2010 Copa Libertadores First Stage]] |result1=CLFS |col_CSSS=#97DEFF|text_CSSS=[[2010 Copa Sudamericana#Second stage|2010 Copa Sudamericana Second Stage]] |result2=CSSS |col_CSFS=#BBEBFF|text_CSFS=[[2010 Copa Sudamericana#First stage|2010 Copa Sudamericana First Stage]] |result4=CSFS|result5=CSFS |update=December 9, 2009 |source= |class_rules=1st points. If more than two clubs are tied on points, the following will be used as a tiebreaker: 1st goal difference; 2nd goals scored; 3rd away-goals scored; 4th draw of lots }} == Relegation == Relegations is determined at the end of the season by computing an average ({{langx|es|promedio}}) of the number of points earned per game over the past three seasons. The team with the lowest average is relegated to the [[Segunda División de Paraguay|División Intermedia]] for the following season. The team who earned the most points over two legs was promoted— or remained —in the Primera División. Should there be a tie in points, goal difference was taken into account, followed a penalty shootout if needed.
